name: Jashub
title: Son of Issachar
summary: Jashub (also known as Jashub or Job) was one of the sons of Issachar, Jacob's son. He was among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family. Jashub became the ancestor of the Jashubites, a clan within the tribe of Issachar.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among Jacob's descendants
keyEvents.description: Jashub is listed as one of Issachar's four sons in the genealogy of Jacob's descendants.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Jashub was among Jacob's family members who went down to Egypt during the famine, when Joseph was vizier in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Recorded in Israel's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jashub is listed in the Book of Numbers as the ancestor of the clan of the Jashubites during the census in the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jashub is again mentioned as a son of Issachar in the genealogies of Chronicles, confirming his place in the tribal history of Israel.
